issues.subject: dc-us-na datacenter label
issues.evidence: The PNG says 'North America Data Center dc-us-na [US]' but omits the City C city-level location supplied by project config; 1 of 5 private-DC containers lacks a city label.

issues.subject: Azure East US topology
issues.evidence: The Azure area contains only an EDW Subnet, firewall, and SYS-38; no Hub VNET, Spoke VNET, gateway, centralized DNS, or monitoring boundary is shown.

issues.subject: six unique cross-site boundary pairs
issues.evidence: Plant-dc-us, plant-dc-cn-primary, plant-dc-us-na, dc-us-na-dc-cn-primary, dc-cn-secondary-dc-us-na, and dc-us-na-Azure all use generic 'private WAN/connectivity' wording rather than MPLS/equivalent, ExpressRoute, or another approved carrier type; 6 of 6 types are missing while 6 of 6 encryption labels are present.

issues.subject: runtime metadata for 16 of 44 technical components
issues.evidence: Runtime is absent for SYS-22 through SYS-31 except none in that range, SYS-34 through SYS-38, and azure-edw-firewall; exact missing IDs: SYS-22,SYS-23,SYS-24,SYS-25,SYS-26,SYS-27,SYS-28,SYS-29,SYS-30,SYS-31,SYS-34,SYS-35,SYS-36,SYS-37,azure-edw-firewall,SYS-38.

issues.subject: technology stack for 8 of 23 custom components
issues.evidence: After exempting Nginx and SAP/commercial endpoints, stack metadata is absent for SYS-04,SYS-26,SYS-27,SYS-28,SYS-29,SYS-32,SYS-33,SYS-37.

issues.subject: Kafka consumer-side direction
issues.evidence: 4 of 24 Kafka-labeled interaction segments originate at a Kafka hub (SYS-25 once and SYS-30 three times) and point toward a firewall; the mandated notation requires producer and consumer relationships to point toward Kafka.

issues.subject: SYS-26 through SYS-29 integration bindings
issues.evidence: 4 of 73 interactions are labeled 'HTTPS or Kafka/TLS' with alternative authentication mechanisms instead of one selected protocol and authentication contract per arrow.

issues.subject: Internet to plant-edge ingress
issues.evidence: The sole external ingress is drawn from an Internet node directly to SYS-01 VIP. Neither SYS-01 nor the plant boundary appliance is explicitly identified as the mandatory F5 stack, and the image conflicts with the blueprint note that this is plant-intranet-only access.

issues.subject: private-cloud operational access
issues.evidence: The blueprint declares Office Network -> MFA -> PAW -> management plane, but the PNG contains no Office Network, PAW node, management-plane path, JIT control, or session-audit path across any of the five private-DC containers.

issues.subject: SYS-38 Azure endpoint
issues.evidence: The blueprint says a private endpoint is required, but the PNG does not show a Private Endpoint, Private DNS, or disabled public access for SYS-38.

issues.subject: physical zones and technical components
issues.evidence: Static inspection finds 42 of 73 rendered vertices with dashed borders; the visible physical Zone containers and many deployed service components are dashed even though physical entities must use solid borders.

issues.subject: EXISTING/NEW migration labeling
issues.evidence: Of 38 SYS components, 4 are EXISTING, 13 are NEW, and all 21 plant systems omit lifecycle status; interactions contain 9 EXISTING, 25 NEW, and 39 TBD labels.

issues.subject: plant autonomy evidence
issues.evidence: The blueprint documents local K8s, PostgreSQL HA, a durable SYS-17 outbox, replay, cached identity/authorization, and WAN-independent operation, but those autonomy controls are not legible as an explicit bounded plant-edge capability on the PNG.

issues.subject: dense interaction labels
issues.evidence: All 73 arrows are labeled, but labels heavily overlap nodes, labels, and edges in the 1254x2206 PNG; several service names and security labels are clipped or visually inseparable in the plant and CN/NA integration zones.

issues.subject: credential-management visibility
issues.evidence: The blueprint declares encrypted Kubernetes Secrets, vault-backed rotation, and Azure Key Vault with managed identity, and SAP IDOC/RFC paths use mTLS plus least-privilege technical users; however, no secret store, Key Vault, credential flow, or rotation note is visible on the PNG.
